source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary: Combat Patrol offers small-scale 40K games for newcomers and experienced players, with matches lasting up to an hour. [Pick a patrol](vsdata:core-rule/combat-patrol.select-combat-patrols), typically based on the miniatures in its boxed set. Skip points totals and custom list building. Each patrol has an assigned mission. Completing it earns VP, and the highest total at the end wins. Try other factions to learn their tactics, strengths and weaknesses before moving on to larger battles.
